description: This multi-level pie chart illustrates a hierarchy of medical ethics principles, featuring an inner ring of four primary categories and an outer ring of twenty-six specific sub-categories. The inner ring is divided into four solid-colored slices: the largest is "Beneficence" in blue (occupying approximately 40% of the chart), followed by "Autonomy" in green (roughly 25%), "Justice" in orange (roughly 20%), and "Non-Maleficence" in purple (roughly 15%). The outer ring consists of lighter-colored slices that correspond to and subdivide the inner categories, appearing roughly equal in size within their respective groups. The light blue section contains eleven slices labeled Recognize the Responsibility of the Occupation, Comply with Laws and Regulations, Provide Medical Care to Patients, Continual Learning, Provide Assistance in Emergency, Respect and Cooperate with Colleagues, Respect Life, Dignity of Patients, Give Top Priority to Patient's Interest in Conflict of Interests, Minimizing Conflicts of Interest, Ethical research, and Open Discussion and Fair Charging of Fees. The light green section contains seven slices: Respect the Decision-making of Incompetent/Competent Patient, Respect Patient's Rights to be Informed, Freedom of Choice, Maintain Truthful, Factual Communication, Keep Confidential of Patient's Information, Professional Relationship with Patients and Their Relatives, Make Responsible and Independent Clinical Judgement, and Physician Can Freely Choose Whom to Serve. The light purple section includes four slices: Prevent Patient from Harm, Maintain Qualified When Providing Medical Care, Report Unethical and Unprofessional Conduct, and Do Not Use Medicine for Personal Gain. The light orange section comprises four slices: Promote the Health of Community and Public Education, Promote Environmental Sustainability, Allocate Medical Sources Fairly, and Treat Patients Fairly and Equally. The chart does not include a separate legend or numerical percentage labels; instead, all text labels are placed directly inside the slices, with the inner ring labels bolded and the outer ring labels rotated radially to fit the segments. No slices are visually emphasized through exploding or offsetting.
